column1: # MEND paper showcase prompts (scripts/gen_hires.py --prompts data/showcase_prompts.tsv; figures scripts/showcase_figs.py).
# Format: prompt_id <TAB> source <TAB> tag <TAB> aspect <TAB> prompt. Seeds 0,1,2,3 for every method; the initial latent
# of (prompt_id, seed) is eval_suite.initial_latent(seed, sha1(prompt_id)), identical across methods at a given
# resolution, so a row of a figure starts from the same noise. All renders are square at native 512 or 1024 px.
# Sources: drawbench = verbatim DrawBench; parti = verbatim or near-verbatim PartiPrompts; geneval = GenEval template;
# custom = written for this figure set (long = long descriptive prompt). Tags: people, animal, text, count, compose,
# scene, style, hard (prompts that are hard for SD3.5-M in general; no per-example failure figure is made).
